hero.title: Fill the calendar, quiet the phone.
hero.lead: Sedir lets your customers book their own appointments around the clock, sends the reminders and offers cancelled slots to your waiting list. You get on with your work.
hero.note: No credit card needed, set-up takes ten minutes.

features.title: Everything about bookings, on one calm screen.
features.lead: Calendar, reminders, waiting list and payments know about each other; you never type the same thing twice.

steps.title: Take your first booking in three steps.
steps.lead: No technical skills needed. If you get stuck, our team joins you on a screen share.

items.title: Add your services
items.text: Enter service names, durations and prices, then mark your opening hours and breaks.

items.title: Share your link
items.text: Add your personal booking page to your Instagram profile, your Google business listing and your website.

items.title: Watch the bookings arrive
items.text: New appointments land in your calendar; Sedir sends the reminders while you focus on your work.

testimonials.title: Businesses that put the phone down.
testimonials.lead: From hair salons to dental clinics, from one-person studios to three-branch businesses.

pricing.title: Pay as you grow.
pricing.lead: Free if you work on your own. When your team grows, switch plans with a single click.
pricing.note: Prices exclude VAT. Pay yearly and get two months free; cancel in any month.

faq.title: Questions you may have
faq.lead: If your question is not answered here, write to us; we reply within one business day.

cta.title: Your first booking is ten minutes away.
cta.lead: Try every feature free for 14 days. If it is not for you, you pay nothing.
